briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ +0.3%, S&P 500 +0.3%) with no clear risk-on signal. Top candidates show bullish RSI/MACD setups but lack the volume-surge confirmation needed for high-conviction entries, so we're holding our 7 positions and keeping cash in reserve for a stronger setup.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a genuinely strong opportunity appears. On a neutral day like today, with no candidates showing full multi-signal confirmation (momentum, trend, and volume all aligned), it's often better to hold cash than to force a trade just to stay fully invested.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指投資者預留在場邊的現金，待真正出現強勁機會時才部署。像今日這種中性市況，沒有候選股票同時具備動量、趨勢及成交量三重訊號確認，持有現金觀望，往往比勉強買入以求「全倉」更為明智。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices traded roughly flat today, with both the NASDAQ and S&P 500 up about 0.3%, reflecting a lack of strong directional catalysts. Without major news driving sentiment, investors largely stayed on the sidelines, consolidating recent gains rather than pushing into new highs. This kind of quiet, low-volatility session often precedes a bigger move once a clearer catalyst emerges.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市窄幅徘徊，納斯達克指數及標普500指數均微升約0.3%，反映市場缺乏明顯的方向性催化劑。由於未有重大消息左右情緒，投資者普遍觀望，鞏固近期升幅而非進一步造好。這種低波動的平靜市況，往往是醞釀下一輪較大行情的前奏。
